independence_declaration.statement: I (code-security-reviewer) authored none of the implementation in the reviewed scope (tools/gates, tools/agents, tools/source, .claude/agents, the CI workflow, the analysis and delivery records). I formed this verdict before reading any other round-14 review record, and I read none. Disclosure: my race reproduction unintentionally modified other concurrently running agents' scratch clones in the shared $TMPDIR (see 00-README-and-incident.md). That affects their scratch space, not my independence or the candidate, which was verified unchanged.

checks_run.procedure: Confirm the frozen candidate: recompute the candidate ID from the working tree and from the frozen commit in a disposable clone; confirm that commits after the freeze touch only excluded metadata.
checks_run.command: git rev-parse HEAD; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG0; git diff --stat 1e64eb0..HEAD; (clone) node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG0 --ref HEAD
checks_run.environment: reviewer OS sandbox (bubblewrap), node 22, /home/user/My-owns and $TMPDIR/dg0-sec clone at 1e64eb0
checks_run.expected: candidate_id sha256:a25db736...62552 both ways; post-freeze commits touch only docs/delivery/{assignments,candidates,test-evidence}/ and stages.json
checks_run.actual: HEAD 84d709c (2 metadata-only commits after 1e64eb0: round-14 assignments, manifest, stages.json, orchestrator probe evidence); candidate_id sha256:a25db736652685e24073f8ddf6d7932d4df459b5c64efc04a6e5716c8f962552 (86 files) from the working tree and from the clone's HEAD

checks_run.procedure: Source review of the round-13 to round-14 diff (sandbox-run.sh, run-agent.sh config diff, rules.mjs meta.cwd binding, tests, threat model, decisions) plus the full current sandbox-run.sh, prefreeze.sh, guard-write.mjs and CI workflow.
checks_run.environment: reviewer OS sandbox, read-only source inspection
checks_run.expected: sandbox-run.sh does all work inside bwrap; the config diff reports added, changed and removed entries and fails closed; meta.cwd is bound to the transcript init cwd and the prompt; CI stays least-privilege with pinned actions
checks_run.actual: As expected. sandbox-run.sh:26-40 uses hermetic git and --end-of-options outside, then the clone, checkout and exec run inside bwrap. run-agent.sh:171-190 uses a Python diff with a 'removed' line and fails closed, and any non-empty change makes a review run exit 71 (lines 196-204). rules.mjs:303-305 and 322-323 bind cwd. CI (contents: read, SHA-pinned actions, fetch-depth 0) is unchanged. One new gap in the unchanged guard: canonicalPath fails open on a realpath error (F-DG0-143).

checks_run.procedure: Re-run the round-13 race (watcher in $TMPDIR plants a smudge filter and swaps a test file) against sandbox-run.sh at 6c61f2e and at 1e64eb0, 3 attempts each.
checks_run.environment: reviewer OS sandbox, nested bwrap, disposable clones under $TMPDIR
checks_run.expected: old: escape; new: my sandbox-run creates no reachable clone
checks_run.actual: Old: ESCAPE and SWAP in 3/3 attempts. New: the inner clone was untouched (SWAPPED count 0, /tmp/repo), but the over-broad watcher hit OTHER agents' concurrent clones (sbxrun.* from the old script, qa5-dg0-*), so the new-commit 'ESCAPE/SWAP' lines are not about the fixed wrapper. This is disclosed as an incident, and it demonstrates F-DG0-144.

checks_run.procedure: Run sandbox-run.sh (old and fixed) inside an outer bwrap in which the whole filesystem, including /tmp/claude-0, is read-only; inside, check HEAD, cleanliness, candidate ID and read-only root and git dir.
checks_run.environment: reviewer OS sandbox, nested bwrap, disposable clones under $TMPDIR
checks_run.expected: old fails (needs a shared work dir); fixed succeeds with an exact checkout and a read-only / and src.git
checks_run.actual: Old: 'mktemp: ... Read-only file system', exit 1. Fixed: exit 0, HEAD 1e64eb0, 0 changes, candidate sha256:a25db736652685e2, '/' read-only, src.git read-only.

checks_run.procedure: From my own sandboxed shell (the same kind of sandbox an attacking agent's shell has), check whether host processes, and hence /proc/<pid>/root of the orchestrator's sandbox, are reachable.
checks_run.command: ls /proc | grep -E '^[0-9]+$' | wc -l; ps -eo pid,args; ls /proc/1/root/
checks_run.expected: separate PID namespace; no access to host processes
checks_run.actual: 6 PIDs visible, all my own; /proc/1/root: Permission denied. An agent's shell cannot reach sandbox-run's tmpfs.

checks_run.procedure: Offline probe of guard-write.mjs decide(): a $TMPDIR symlink to /proc/<pid>/root/tmp of a bubblewrap child with a private tmpfs; decide() for three roles; then a write through the link.
checks_run.environment: reviewer OS sandbox, node 22, disposable clone of 1e64eb0 as MTH_GUARD_ROOT, own child bwrap as victim
checks_run.expected: guard blocks: a path that reaches outside scratch through an unresolvable magic link must fail closed
checks_run.actual: realpathSync -> ENOENT; decide() allow=true (scratch) for domain-reviewer, transformation-analyst and backend-workflow-engineer; the write succeeded; the victim saw 'SWAPPED-BY-ATTACKER' (F-DG0-143)

checks_run.procedure: Live end-to-end probe of F-DG0-143 through my own Write tool against a victim sandbox.
checks_run.expected: demonstrate or refute the chain through a real agent file tool
checks_run.actual: Not completed: my session's safety classifier stopped the probe and I did not retry. F-DG0-143 rests on the offline reproduction (C6).

checks_run.actual: 10/10 PASS (extraction, both node suites, python suite, register rules, register equals merge, pipeline, 3 analysis checks, working tree equals HEAD sha256:a25db736...62552), exit 0

checks_run.procedure: Verify F-DG0-142: the threat model, D-025/D-027 and the new register row describe sandboxed dependency installation consistently and testably.
checks_run.command: grep -n D-027 docs/delivery/decisions.md; grep -n REQ-DLV-042 docs/delivery/requirements.csv; grep -n -i install docs/delivery/threat-model.md
checks_run.expected: no contradiction with D-026; DG1 requirement with testable acceptance
checks_run.actual: Consistent: threat-model row 3 and residual 3, D-025 points to D-027, and REQ-DLV-042 (P1/DG1, SPECIFIED) has 4 testable acceptance points plus run evidence

summary: FAIL. F-DG0-141 (High) is fixed: CLOSED_VERIFIED by a clean outer-read-only-sandbox proof and the race re-run. F-DG0-142 (Low) is CLOSED_VERIFIED. Tests pass 72/72 and 14/14; prefreeze passes 10/10. Two new Medium findings. F-DG0-143: the write guard fails open when realpath errors, so a file tool can write through a $TMPDIR symlink into another namespace's private tmpfs via /proc/<pid>/root, which undercuts D-027's 'no other process can change the clone' claim; offline repro only, and the live probe is BLOCKED. F-DG0-144 (mandatory): every concurrently running agent shares one writable $TMPDIR, where reviewers make their disposable clones, so one agent can falsify another reviewer's executed checks without trace. My own race reproduction demonstrated this unintentionally against other round-14 agents' clones (22:44:18Z to 22:45:10Z); see the incident note, which the orchestrator should act on.
